## Objective

Records can name entities in Arabic and English and relate to each other with evidence.

## Scope

As stated in the objective and acceptance criteria; nothing beyond them.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] An entity has aliases in both languages and one identifier
- [ ] a relationship has a type, evidence and a validity period
- [ ] a check reports links that point at nothing

## Test requirements

Integration tests with synthetic bilingual data.
